literal_meaning: কষ্টে (সৃষ্টে) – কষ্ট এবং সৃষ্টির সাথে (যুগ্ম শব্দের মাধ্যমে কঠোর পরিশ্রমের ইঙ্গিত)
figurative_meaning_en: rhyming expression; with much/great hardship; somehow or by any means
similar_in_english: by the sweat of one's brow
example_sentences_in_bangla: অল্প আয়ে কষ্টেসৃষ্টে দিন চলে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: With low income, days pass in hardship and struggle.
They manage their family with great difficulty and toil.
note: This is a rhyming compound word (যুগ্মশব্দ) commonly used in colloquial Bengali to express enduring hardship.
